```plato
    // Rigid transforms are closed under composition: apply `first`, then
    // `second`, with no matrix round-trip and no drift out of the family.
    Compose(first: IRigid2D, second: IRigid2D): Pose2D
        => first.Pose2D.Compose(second.Pose2D);
```

```plato

    // Compose through the affine closure. TRS is not closed under composition
    // (rotating a non-uniform scale leaves the TRS family); the product is the
    // matrix form of first-then-second, re-read as TRS with unit shear assumed.
    // Prefer AffineTransform2D.Compose when the result must stay exact.
    Compose(first: TrsTransform2D, second: TrsTransform2D): AffineTransform2D
        => AffineTransform2D(first).Compose(AffineTransform2D(second));
```

## Line 1438

**Source:** [stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato, line 1438](../../../../../stdlib/foundation/transforms.library.plato#L1438).

```plato

    // Compose through the matrix product, then re-decompose into TRS.
    // Precondition: the product is a scale-rotate-translate composition
    // (Decompose succeeds); shear is not representable as TrsTransform3D.
    Compose(first: TrsTransform3D, second: TrsTransform3D): TrsTransform3D
        => TrsTransform3D(first.Matrix4x4 * second.Matrix4x4);
```
